elements.label: Figure 1.18
elements.title: Side Tab of Colab
elements.details: Screenshot showing the side tab of Google Colaboratory interface with icons including Files (highlighted), Search, Snippets, and a folder icon labeled 'Files'.
elements.summary: This image shows the location of the Files icon on the side tab of Google Colaboratory, which is the first step to accessing files in Google Drive.

elements.label: Figure 1.19
elements.title: Features under Files on Colab
elements.details: Screenshot showing the Files pane in Google Colaboratory with folders bin, boot, content, datalab, and an icon labeled 'Mount Drive' highlighted.
elements.summary: This image illustrates the Files pane in Colab and highlights the Mount Drive icon used to connect Google Drive to the notebook.

elements.label: Figure 1.20
elements.title: An Inserted Cell to Mount Your Google Drive
elements.details:
Screenshot of a code cell in a Colab notebook containing the code: 'from google.colab import drive
drive.mount('/content/drive')' with a blue pop-up box overlay saying 'Run this cell to mount your Google Drive. Learn more Dismiss'.
elements.summary: This image shows the inserted code cell that mounts Google Drive in the Colab notebook, enabling access to files stored in Drive.
